metastasis_patterns.denominator_note: Counts are individual metastatic lesions across 43 autopsied cases. % is lesion count / total mets (96), NOT % of patients with mets there. Read as approximate site involvement pattern in disseminated disease.

biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common driver in classic PTC and tall cell variant; associated with adverse clinicopathologic features and risk of recurrence in some series, though independent prognostic strength varies by cohort; predictive for BRAF-directed therapy in advanced BRAF V600E-mutant thyroid carcinoma, including dabrafenib/trametinib in anaplastic thyroid carcinoma and vemurafenib/dabrafenib use in selected RAI-refractory differentiated thyroid carcinoma; potential redifferentiation strategy

biomarkers.name: RAS mutations (NRAS, HRAS, KRAS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common in follicular-patterned PTC, especially follicular variant; molecular classification

biomarkers.name: RET fusions (RET/PTC1, RET/PTC3)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~5-15% sporadic adult PTC; higher in pediatric and radiation-associated tumors
biomarkers.clinical_use: Oncogenic driver in a subset of PTC; selpercatinib and pralsetinib for RET fusion-positive advanced thyroid cancer

biomarkers.name: NTRK fusions
biomarkers.clinical_use: Actionable driver in a small subset of PTC; larotrectinib, entrectinib (tissue-agnostic approvals)

biomarkers.name: TERT promoter mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: ~5-15% in PTC (higher in aggressive histology and older patients)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse prognostic marker; especially unfavorable when co-occurring with BRAF V600E

biomarkers.name: Thyroglobulin
biomarkers.clinical_use: Post-thyroidectomy and post-RAI surveillance marker for residual/recurrent differentiated thyroid carcinoma; unreliable if anti-Tg antibodies present

biomarkers.name: Anti-thyroglobulin antibodies
biomarkers.clinical_use: Interfere with Tg assay; serial trends can serve as a surrogate marker of persistent disease

biomarkers.name: Afirma GSC / ThyroSeq / ThyGeNEXT+ThyraMIR
biomarkers.clinical_use: Molecular tests for cytologically indeterminate (Bethesda III/IV) FNA — aid rule-out/rule-in decisions for surgery

biomarkers.name: ALK fusions
biomarkers.clinical_use: Rare oncogenic driver in PTC; potentially actionable in advanced ALK fusion-positive thyroid carcinoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Papillary architecture with characteristic nuclear features (nuclear enlargement, overlapping, grooves, pseudoinclusions, powdery chromatin — 'Orphan Annie eye')
variants: follicular variant (encapsulated noninvasive FVPTC now often reclassified as NIFTP)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not formally graded; aggressive variants (tall cell, columnar, hobnail, solid) worse. Nuclear features are diagnostic hallmark

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrovascular papillary cores; psammoma bodies (concentric calcifications)

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — thyroid diverticulum from the primitive pharyngeal floor/foramen cecum
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains follicular differentiation — TSH-responsive, iodine-avid, thyroglobulin-producing; this differentiation is exploited therapeutically (RAI ablation, TSH suppression)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Progressive dedifferentiation drives poorly differentiated and anaplastic thyroid carcinoma — cumulative MAPK-pathway activation with additional alterations such as TERT promoter and TP53 can produce lineage regression; RAI-refractory disease reflects loss of iodine-avidity (NIS downregulation)
